messages:
carly: Heads-up: we're rolling out a docs site reorganization and an SDK change that affects sync helpers. Posting timeline + migration steps here so teams can coordinate.

owen: TL;DR?

carly: Short version: docs tree is being restructured to separate 'Guides' vs 'Reference' (helps SEO & translations). SDK change: we're deprecating `client.sync_*` helpers in favor of an explicit async-first API surface. Deprecation begins today; compatibility shim for 60 days; removal in ~120 days.

mina: Any customer-visible breakage immediately?

carly: No breakage right now. v1.2 of redwood-sdk adds deprecation warnings when legacy sync helpers are imported. They will still work during the compatibility window. We will log a WARN with migration link.

owen: What exactly are the API changes to call out in release notes?

carly: Two key items to highlight: 1) sync helpers removed from the top-level `Client` (e.g., `client.sync_generate`) — replace with `async for chunk in client.stream_generate(...)` or `client.generate(...).result()` depending on sync needs. 2) The HTTP client now retries idempotent requests with exponential backoff by default; retry config lives in `client.config.retries`. Add guidance for workloads that must be strictly single-attempt.

mina: Example snippets for the migration page?

carly: Added these to the docs PR but pasting short examples here: 
```
# old (sync helper)
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key)
# blocking call
resp = client.sync_generate(prompt)

# new (async-first)
from redwood.client import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key)
async for chunk in client.stream_generate(prompt):
    process(chunk)

# sync wrapper if you must block (not recommended)
import asyncio
result = asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(client.generate(prompt))
```

owen: Good. Where are we publishing the migration docs and what about lingering examples across repos?

carly: Migration guide is at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/610 and will be live under /sdk/migrate/sync-to-async. We're also running an examples sweep; docs CI will add a lint that flags `sync_generate` usage and suggests the migration snippet.

mina: Timeline for docs reorg deploy?

carly: Staging deploy is immediate. Production deploy planned for 2026-06-10 after translations and quick sanity checks. Deprecation window: warnings start now (today), compat shim until 2026-08-10, removal targeted 2026-10-08.

devrel-bot: release published: redwood-sdk 1.2.0 (deprecation warnings + docs links) https://pypi.org/project/redwood-sdk/1.2.0 :party_parrot:

docs-bot: Docs site updated on staging: reorganized Guide / Reference split. Migration page added at /sdk/migrate/sync-to-async. CDN purge scheduled 07:00 UTC on deploy day.

ops-bot: Note: added an alert rule to track 404s for relocated pages. If 404 rate > 5/min for any moved path, ops will auto-roll back.

owen: What about SDK telemetry or config changes tied to this release?

carly: No telemetry changes. We added `client.config.http.retries` and `client.config.http.timeout` defaults; explained in the reference section so customers can tune for long-running calls.

mina: Support playbook? I'll draft KB entries for: migration steps, common asyncio errors and how to run the sync wrapper, and how to turn off automatic retries if needed.

carly: Thanks. Also: please add canned GitHub issue replies for customers who open tickets about the deprecation warning. Link to migration guide + example snippets.

devrel-bot: Webinar scheduled: "Migrating to async RedwoodClient" — 30min session next Tue 16:00 UTC. Registration link will appear in docs and community.

docs-bot: Action items posted in the PR description: 1) docs: add redirects for moved pages; 2) devrel: publish migration blog + webinar; 3) SDK: ship a quick patch if any high-severity bug is found during compatibility window.

owen: One more ask: can we add a short one-line checklist for customers at the top of the migration page (3 bullets)?

carly: Already added: "1) Replace sync_* calls with stream/generate examples; 2) If blocking behavior needed, wrap with asyncio.run() temporarily; 3) Update CI to fail on sync helper usage before removal."

mina: I'll prepare the support KB and a script to scan repos for `sync_generate` in examples and open PRs to fix.

carly: Great. Thanks everyone. We'll post a final reminder in #general before production deploy. :rocket:
